title.narrative: Support the integration of greening TVET in Education Sector in Ethiopia

description.narrative: In a world undergoing multiple transitions, Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) has a critical role to play in the recovery and reshaping of education systems and labour markets worldwide. Technical and vocational education and training (TVET) can help people skill, upskill, and reskill to meet the needs of the new age and navigate these transitions. TVET equips individuals with the competencies they need for decent work and life, contributing to build a peaceful, healthy, just, and sustainable world. To better integrate greening education in Ethiopia UNESCO LO, MoE and the MOLS the activity conduct case study related to the development of operational standard on greening TVET in Ethiopia.
